summary: Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Amended and Restated LLC Agreement for Frontier Power USA Parent, LLC, a JV with Cerberus affiliate CCM Frontier and Hudson Bay affiliate HBC. Eos contributed $112.6M for Class B Units; CCM contributed $100M for Class A-2 Units and founder's equity; HBC contributed $50M for Class C Units. The filing establishes a new JV entity, likely to be spun off or operated as a separate vehicle, though no explicit spin-off is stated. What to watch: operational separation and future ownership transfers.
